newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSA, FOREX MOST ACTIVE, MARKET SEEN STABLE.
newsitem.headline: HANSA, FOREX MOST ACTIVE, MARKET SEEN STABLE.

text.p: * Total trade on the Estonian bourse on Tuesday was 63.9
million kroons versus 47 million kroons on Monday.
* The Talse index gained 0.61 percent to close at 259.16.
* Hansapank was most traded in turnover of 17.9
million kroons to end at 135 kroons vs 134.18 kroons.
* Forekspank was traded at 16.96 million kroons
to end lower at 180.50 kroons vs 183.25 kroons.
* Dealers said a stable and slow period has started in the
market which is expected to continue during the following
Trade on the Tallinn Stock Exchange was moderate on Tuesday with Hansapank and Forekspank the most active stocks and dealers said the market looked like it would remain stable for a few weeks.
Forekspank saw trade of 16.96 million kroons to end lower at 180.50 kroons vs 183.25 kroons, a fall which baffled dealers.
"This is a strange trend, because Forekspank was expected to keep rising," one dealer said.
Farmaatsiatehas was the biggest loser on the main list to close at 113.15 kroons vs 116 kroons on Monday in light turnover.
"Farmaatsiatehas is a share with seasonal activity and it has been influenced by recent news," a dealer said.
Farmaatsiatehas on Monday gained three kroons to close at 116 kroons after it announced its intention to establish a Russian factory and raised its 1997 profit estimate.
On the free market, Norma was most active share in trade of 2.35 million kroons to close lower at 73 kroons vs 74 kroons on Monday.
Dealers said a stable and slow period is expected during the next few weeks.
